title: The two-ending choice (seal vs open barrow) is impactful but could be more salient before reaching the throne — perhaps hint at the reeve/priest conflict in the notice board more explicitly

evidence.quote: The two-ending choice (seal vs open barrow) is impactful but could be more salient before reaching the throne — perhaps hint at the reeve/priest conflict in the notice board more explicitly
Final choice between sealing/opening barrow: options were presented but consequences (reeve satisfaction vs priest disappointment) were only revealed in the ending, not beforehand
Early NPCs like the reeve and gray priest mention choices about sealing/opening the barrow, but their actual mechanical impact on the ending wasn't obvious until much later
The 'promise reeve' vs 'please priest' choice felt telegraphed but didn't require explicit decision — consider making it a hard choice that gates endings more clearly
Make the moral choice between sealing (reeve) vs opening (priest) the barrow more explicit earlier, so players understand the stakes
